conflicts.note: No confirmed IR press release ('Rubrik to Report Third Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results') was found this pass. Historical pattern: FY2026 Q3 (quarter ended Oct 31, 2025) was reported Thursday Dec 4, 2025, announced via press release on Nov 10, 2025; FY2027 Q1 was reported June 4, 2026; FY2027 Q2 was reported Aug 27, 2026 (quarter ended July 31, 2026, so FY2027 Q3 quarter end is Oct 31, 2026). This supports an early-December 2026 date (Thursday Dec 3, 2026 would match the prior year's Thursday pattern) but none of the four estimates could be confirmed or eliminated.
